plurals.name: home_text
plurals.item: Away %d day. The imps threw a party, but the tower kept your seat warm. Your first spell today counts double.
Away %d days. The imps threw a party, but the tower kept your seat warm. Your first spell today counts double.

resources.string: The tower kept your seat warm
The imps had a little party. No harm done. One small spell, whenever you\'re ready.
On the windowsill of the %s. Tap to pick it up.
Found by the %s while you slept.
Through the window, as cats do. It looked at the tidy floor, purred, and decided to stay. It will sleep wherever it\'s cleanest. What shall we call it?
%s slept through the whole week and regrets nothing.
Every time a spell climbs a rank (Apprentice, Adept, Master, Archmage), a new star lights up over the Observatory.
Every reagent you bring from the market leaves an essence on the alchemy shelf. Brew them into potions: they do nothing useful at all, and make the tower prettier for a week.
What the apprentice wears on the tower and on every floor. Tap to buy with mana, tap again to change.
Every imp you have shown the door. Which one moves in depends on the room and the season, never on how long a chore waited.
Little things the helpers find after a quiet night on a tidy floor.
Keep a floor tidy overnight and its awake helpers may leave something on the windowsill. Gifts wait three days. A few are rare, and an acorn or a star shard goes into a potion now and then.
The helpers are waiting at the table to tell you about the week.

plurals.name: tea_casts
plurals.item: You cast %d spell this week. It counted.

resources.string: The %s worked hardest and has earned a biscuit.
Not a single imp stayed for tea.
Pour another cup. Next week can wait till Monday.
The kettle hums. The tower is warm. That will do nicely.
Whatever was left undone will still be there, and so will we.
A good week. Have the last biscuit, you earned it.
It\'s in the tower. Place it from the chest in the decor shop.
A map of what you\'ve learnt
Each rank a spell climbs lights one star. They fill the constellations one by one, and the finished ones shine over the roof at night.
Reagents from the market leave essences here. A potion needs a few, sometimes a trinket too, and makes the tower prettier for a week.
Robes and hats for mana. The pointed hat takes the colour of your robe. You\'ll walk about every floor in whatever you choose.
Every imp you send packing is written down here, with its habits. Some only haunt one room, a few only come in their season.
We tidy at night too, you know. When a floor stays clean, we find things and leave them on the sill for you.
Your tower with its windows: warm where it\'s tidy, violet where imps moved in.
